retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the fire that began in the Grandella store on 25 August 1988 and destroyed a large part of the Chiado. Its consequence is the reconstruction Álvaro Siza directed over the following two decades, which the atlas does not hold; without that record there is nothing here for an edge to reach, and a link to anything else would be invented. Revisit when the reconstruction is written.
